- **Geography:** Pennsylvania, all of the United States, and Ireland
- **Surname variants:** Flynn, Flyn, Flinn, Fl\*nn (wildcard)

3. He may simply not be present in the FamilySearch index

- Search **external genealogy sites** (Ancestry, MyHeritage, FindMyPast, etc.) for Bartholomew Flynn
- Browse **unindexed image volumes** for relevant Pennsylvania or Irish record sets
- Consider a **full-text search** of document transcripts on FamilySearch
